name: pyautogui_app
description:
Manage Linux GUI applications: list open windows, launch a new app, focus/raise a window, move or resize a window.

Modes:
- `list` — return all visible named windows with IDs and geometry
- `launch` — start an app by command (e.g. "xcalc", "gedit", "firefox")
- `focus` — bring a window to front by window_id
- `move` — reposition a window to (x, y)
- `resize` — set window dimensions to width × height

window_id.description: X11 window ID (modes: focus, move, resize)

wait.description: Seconds to wait after launch before returning (default 1.5)
